preconditions.description: The number of operations q is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.description: Each assignment name ai consists of lowercase English letters and has length between 1 and 15.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= 10**9 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.split()[0] == 'set')
preconditions.description: Each priority xi in a set operation is between 1 and 1,000,000,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= di < i for i, line in enumerate(stdin.splitlines()[1:], 1) if line.split()[0] == 'undo')
preconditions.description: Each undo operation di is non-negative and less than the current day index i.
The last operation is a query operation.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line.strip() == '-1' or (0 <= int(stdout_line.strip()) <= len({a for op in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if op.split()[0] == 'set' for a in op.split()[1] if op.split()[0] == 'set'}) for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines() if stdout_line.strip() != '')
postconditions.description: For each query operation, the output is either -1 (if the assignment is not present) or a non-negative integer representing the count of assignments with a smaller priority.

postconditions.expression: all((ai in {a for op in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if op.split()[0] == 'set' for a in op.split()[1] if op.split()[0] == 'set'}) == (int(stdout_line.strip()) != -1) for stdout_line, line in zip(stdout.splitlines(), stdin.splitlines()[1:]) if line.split()[0] == 'query' and stdout_line.strip() != '')
postconditions.description: The output for a query is -1 if and only if the queried assignment ai is not present in the to-do list.

postconditions.expression: all((int(stdout_line.strip()) == sum(1 for a, x in current_state.items() if a != ai and x < current_state[ai])) if ai in current_state else int(stdout_line.strip()) == -1 for stdout_line, line in zip(stdout.splitlines(), stdin.splitlines()[1:]) if line.split()[0] == 'query' and stdout_line.strip() != '')
